tip: Marital status uses ser, not estar, even though it can change: ele e solteiro, ela e casada.
Estar marks a changed condition, so spoiled milk is o leite esta estragado, not e estragado.
Portuguese uses 'qual e' where English says what is, to single one out: Qual e a sua comida favorita.
In questions 'por que' is two words. Written as one, 'porque' means because. Here: Por que as coisas estao caras.
'A gente' means we but takes the he/she verb form: a gente vai, never a gente vamos.
'Tao... quanto' is the as...as frame: tao bom quanto caro means as good as it is expensive.
